setting.holdmyitems.enabled.tooltip: Toggle first-person hand and item animations.
setting.holdmyitems.x_offset.tooltip: Horizontal offset applied to first-person hands (-1.0 to 1.0).
setting.holdmyitems.y_offset.tooltip: Vertical offset applied to first-person hands (-1.0 to 1.0).
setting.holdmyitems.z_offset.tooltip: Depth offset applied to first-person hands (-1.0 to 1.0).
setting.holdmyitems.camera_shake.tooltip: Enable subtle camera tilt and recoil synchronized with hand animations.
setting.holdmyitems.particles.tooltip: Enable custom first-person item and screen-space particles (torches, lanterns, swings, petals).
setting.holdmyitems.render_blocks_3d.too: Render held block items with full block-model lighting and placement poses.
setting.holdmyitems.sound_effects.toolti: Play custom sword slash and interaction sounds.
setting.holdmyitems.debug_overlay.toolti: Show Hold My Items animation telemetry in the top-left HUD.
